name: Harmony Touch, Off held, device mode left by Home, and a long press
description: todo-touch 3.2's bench checks 1, 8 and 9 (docs/test-notes/harmony-touch.md), on the bench Harmony Touch with the setup of the full sync recorded for 2.3: Watch TV is the LG TV for display and channels and the Denon for volume, and Switch Box is the KPN for playing and channels, the LG TV for display and volume, and the Switch. Every prediction is a reading of the firmware and of the recorded documents, never seen on a unit. Predicted per step: 1 Watch TV starts, the LG TV and the Denon switched on, nothing judged. 2 Off held for 10 seconds: the screens end the activity at the press, so the LG TV's and the Denon's power off codes go out at once, and the kernel restarts the remote about 8 seconds after the press; note whether and when the screen restarts. If the codes come only after the restart, or not at all, the press did not end the activity. 3 After the restart, Watch TV again, nothing judged. 4 Device mode on the LG TV and then Home: Home on the activity list while Watch TV runs goes to its start screen and ends device mode, so Volume Up sends the Denon's VolumeUp; the LG TV's VolumeUp instead would mean device mode survived Home. 5 Switch Box, nothing judged. 6 A short tap of Rewind sends the KPN's Rewind, on release. 7 Rewind held about 2 seconds sends the KPN's Replay, the long press, on the first hold report at least 550 ms after the press, about 600 ms in practice; nothing on going down, so no Rewind before it. 8 Off ends Switch Box. The monitor names a code by the bench configurations that hold it, so a KPN code those do not hold may arrive unnamed: then read it from the frame log rather than counting the step as failed. The Flirc runs 4.10.7.

steps.instruction: Wait for the restart → Watch TV
Devices → LG TV → Home → Volume Up
